route_title: Seed-Reinitialized Bounded Optimization with Damped Step Size
compilation_rationale: Bounded 24-layer HfO2/SiO2 stack optimized for high transmission in 800–1500 nm and high reflection in 200–400 nm. Initial thicknesses clipped to 45–120 nm bounds. Coherent TMM with smatrix solver at normal incidence. Absolute normal thickness tolerance applied for robustness statistics.
